product.name: Retail Banking Accounts
product.description: Current and savings accounts for individuals, including salary-transfer, micro and interest-bearing account options for managing deposits, payments and everyday banking.

product.name: Corporate Banking and Business Credit
product.description: Banking and credit solutions for medium-sized businesses, large companies, government entities and financial institutions, including short-, medium- and long-term financing.

identifier.value: Digital Banking: Mobile and Internet Banking

product.name: Digital Banking: Mobile and Internet Banking
product.description: Digital banking access for viewing accounts, managing deposits and cards, transferring funds, paying bills and performing selected banking tasks remotely.

product.name: Payment Cards
product.description: Credit, debit and prepaid cards for purchases, cash access, travel and expense management, including consumer, premium, foreign-currency and corporate card options.

product.name: Retail Personal Loans
product.description: Personal financing for employed customers, self-employed professionals, pensioners and customers borrowing against deposits or certificates, including vehicle-purpose financing.

product.name: Auto Loans
product.description: Vehicle financing for employed customers, self-employed customers and professionals to fund the purchase of a car through structured repayment plans.
